reference_policy: Original fig5.pdf--fig15.pdf are sole geometric/line/style truth; actual PPTX only determines placement. No candidate-derived reference or alignment.
method: Same MuPDF 432dpi render. Legend width integrates reference-color opacity over source-selected flat dash interiors; text/hatch/curves have separate masks.
tolerance_basis: At 432dpi one pixel is 1/6pt. 0.20pt width allows about one pixel; 15% prevents genuine broadening. 0.35--0.50pt boundary tolerance absorbs up to 2--3 pixels of renderer/path edge differences, while 10% curve/hatch area and 99% coverage prevent missing/extra shape being hidden. Color checks use full-ink pixels only. Text outline conversion gets separate 15% area allowance and 0.40pt edge tolerance.
